semanticChecks.method: Direct field-by-field self-review of both Chinese locale texts against Japanese canonical source; no peer output read.
semanticChecks.fullTextCoverage: All titles, paragraph bodies, prompts, key terms and two illustration alt texts translated without summarization.
semanticChecks.conditionsAndNegations: Checked distinctions between mechanism/function and suitability/approval; retained all not-only, cannot-infer, not-confirmed, not-received and no-document conditions.
semanticChecks.uncertainty: Retained possible changes after motion begins and inability to infer compatibility from appearance, names, diameter, passage or rating alone.
semanticChecks.technicalTerms: Consistent chain hoist/hand chain/load chain, lever hoist, lifeline tensioner, deflection, fall arrest, wire-rope puller, jack, stroke, axial thrust, earth-retaining support, compression, vertical alignment and reaction-force terminology. Japanese product/trade names retained where needed.
semanticChecks.numbersAndRoles: Checked two-chain distinctions, two-item matching records, three-part tool/object/support diagram and responsibility distinctions. No numerical operating instructions added.
semanticChecks.sourceOnlyScope: No external research or legal claims, load values, installation steps, safety procedures or additional conditions introduced.
semanticChecks.finalCorrections: Standardized session 288 to generic chain hoist because source covers manual and electric variants; retained Japanese キリン name; removed an unnecessarily explicit weight paraphrase from the support-force sentence.

limitations: Chinese translations received author self-review only; no independent native-language or engineering approval.
